[Fix]

🧠 **Memory crashes**: Fixed the app repeatedly restarting on Homey's **memory limit**. The *My Delivery* image was redrawn for **every parcel on every sync**, including old delivered shipments. It is now only drawn when the image is actually viewed.

📦 **"Delivered" too early**: Fixed parcels with the status **"wordt vandaag bezorgd"** being treated as delivered, which made the **Parcel delivered** Flow fire while the courier was still underway.

🖥️ **Full parcel status**: The **My Delivery** widget now shows the complete PostNL status across multiple lines instead of cutting it off with an ellipsis.

[Improvement]

🔄 **Smarter Track & Trace**: Track & Trace is now fetched only for **active parcels** and the **5 most recent deliveries**, at most 3 at a time, instead of every shipment in your account at once.

🗂️ **Leaner parcel history**: Only the **15 most recent delivered shipments** and the last **30 timeline events** per parcel are kept, shrinking the stored data from megabytes to kilobytes.

✉️ **Mail scans**: Scans of incoming mail are reused and no longer downloaded again on every sync.

📱 **Widget refresh**: Open widgets no longer start a full PostNL sync every minute; widget refreshes are now served from recent data (a full sync at most every 3 minutes).

⚡ **Faster image rendering**: The *My Delivery* image renders about **45% faster** with noticeably smaller font and image buffers, while looking exactly the same.

🌟 Enjoy the improved PostNL v1.2.9 App with a more stable, lighter and faster experience.
